resources.string: Your dashboard is being set up
Stores see today\'s orders and sales here. Provincial operators see their whole province.
New orders will ring here so you never miss one.
Your balance, top-ups and monthly store fee will show up here.
Your business profile, staff and settings will live here.
Total orders, gross sales, commissions and active riders will show up here.
Approve new stores, set the monthly store fee and manage top-up wallets here.
Review rider documents, approve riders and see who is online.
Live orders in your province will appear here, with manual rider assignment.
Your license, delivery rates and province settings will live here.
